details:
So the core idea is deplorable item that can be purchased for in game currency. This currency can be purchased as well as earned through daily log on bonuses which increase with VRChat plus. 
What are the items you ask.
Well for one a privacy dome. Basically a small bubble where no audio comes in or goes out.  similar to the new earmuffs but it’s the dome visible to all players in the instance. Instead of this being a pay to place it might be better to charge on a fuel model. Basically you play currency for an hour of dome so you can deploy it for a quick private conversation and pick it up without wasting money.
 Some sort of item that allows for flight. There are avatars that can do this anyways so it’s not like an item to do it would be world ending.
An item that allow for climbing.
Basically you can climb on any world like you would in climbing world.
An item to shrink or grow. Now again there are other avatars for this so it’s more a novelty.
Group Game items. Items that allow for simple games to be played in any world, ranging from hide and go seek, tag, laser tag, race, and hide the object. This would work by the host and buyer  placing a flag other players can click the flag to join.
The host might need to set up additional flags for team spawns and or starting and end flags.
Players can exit a game from their menu. Cosmetics for some of these games could also be sold as they are not part of an avatar.
There are so many other ideas for deployable items a simple chair to sit in or bed, a small golf cart for groups, magic carpets, a laser pointer, maybe even pets!
I’m not insane I know this would be incredibly difficult to implement, it might even be necessary for such a feature to have its own dedicate team. I know a lot of people will complain that it will do hell to performance and be that they could be used to troll. Maybe they are right but damn would it not be cool! Especially with the game  deployables it would allow players to turn ANY world into a game world. There are many choices to be made to how all of these would be implemented. Should people be able to turn them off?
If you block a player will you see his item? 
What if you are in a game and the host blocks you?
How do sound domes work if the owner is blocked? 
How much would each item cost?
What if you leave a dome up and forget to close it? (I think it should disappear when the host leaves it for 15 seconds.)
Why not just use avatar for all this? 
For this last one quite simply because I believe people should have the option to say in their main preferred avatar without using 20 different random avatar each with some obscure avatar magic allowing these abilities.
Lastly this is a method of making additional money from the game. 
Some might not like it but the game must be profitable to survive and I think this would definitely add a source that is not ads or resold features.
They should always be able to be earned, without pay real life money though. These are novelty’s and aid items. You should not pay $0.99 every time you place a privacy dome, but $0.99 for 2-3 hours of dome maybe. Or like 1 week of everyday log in and a quarter of that time for VRchat plus members.
Think about it.
Ps sorry for any typos I have dyslexia and am in a bit of a rush ATM
title: Paid deployable items.
